title: Pilot brush note
description: A closing line for a band: either a big handwritten script line or a medium sans statement, with a thin tapered brush stroke of colour underneath (cyan, pink, violet, yellow or the text colour).
notes: the script face is the theme's --typeface-script, falling back to cursive
name: pilot-brush-note

props.name: text
props.description: the line itself; use \n in sans notes to start a new paragraph

props.name: variant
props.description: script: the big handwritten face · sans: a medium statement

props.name: stroke
props.description: the colour of the brush stroke under it
